# ignitify Provider

Manage an existing Ignitify tenant: users, groups, API keys, secrets, tasks, deployments and hooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"
  required_providers {
    ignitify = {
      source = "ignitify-dev/ignitify"
    }
  }
}

# The key comes from IGNITIFY_API_KEY; do not commit a key.
# Users, groups and API keys need an owner key. Secrets, tasks, deployments
# and hooks work with a user key whose groups grant their permissions.
provider "ignitify" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key. Defaults to the IGNITIFY_API_KEY environment variable. Users, groups and keys need an owner key; secrets, tasks, deployments and hooks work with a user key that holds their permissions.
- `endpoint` (String) The API base URL. Defaults to the IGNITIFY_API_URL environment variable, else https://api.ignitify.dev. Must be https; plain http is accepted only to this machine.
